name: Austral-Campanile

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the north, tectonic rift valleys. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on uranium, iron, aluminum and platinum are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
